title: rosa canina subvar. frondosa
intro: Rosa canina subvar. frondosa, commonly known as Wild Rose or Prickly Rose, is a type of flowering shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various conditions such as digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. frondosa are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation and sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
